Unlike typical coin-operated parking lots such as Times or Mitsui's RePark, this service allows you to easily use vacant spaces in monthly parking lots that are normally unavailable, as well as privately owned parking spaces.

Please use it for outings, drives, and business trips.

Reserve the parking space you want in advance and pay the fee.

Even on busy days or around popular spots, you can be sure to rent a parking space.

【Recommended for those who:】

・Want to avoid the frustration of not being able to find or park in full coin-operated parking lots around event venues, etc.

・Want to secure parking in advance for travel or sightseeing.

・Business professionals whose work involves appointments by car.

・Find it troublesome to search for vacant spaces in coin-operated parking lots.

・Visit locations in residential areas where coin-operated parking is unavailable.

▼You can also rent out your parking space▼

Even individuals can easily rent out their parking space using their smartphone.

If you have space in front of your house or on an empty lot, why not share your empty space with zero initial investment?

By renting out your parking space as an Akippa parking space, you can generate revenue by having people who need it rent it. Since the commission is only charged for usage, you can rest assured that there are no fixed costs for owners in months with no usage.

Rent out your space from the "Owner" tab at the bottom of the app!

# Perfect location and surprising rates?! akippa's new service has been released!

[![akippa広報](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/7275523/profile_fea652bec39520efedab514c4c3067f4.jpg?width=60)](https://note.com/akippa_parking)

[akippa広報](https://note.com/akippa_parking)

2019年5月24日 11:52

Hello, this is Ishikawa from the PR team for the parking reservation app " [akippa](https://www.akippa.com/)".

Thank you for always opening this note.

akippa's new service **" [Subscription Service](https://www.akippa.com/regular/request)", was released yesterday, Thursday, May 23rd, at 2:00 PM!**

Yay!This is our first new service in a while, following the " [Advance Reservation Option](https://www.akippa.com/preorder/about)" announced at the end of last year. Yay!

It has already been picked up by media outlets like the Nikkei and CNET Japan, and we have received requests from many users, making it a truly, truly happy start for the PR team!!!

[**駐車場シェア「akippa」、月極駐車場よりも安く定期利用できる新サービス** _駐車場予約アプリ「akippa」を運営するakippaは5月23日、駐車場シェアリングの「定期利用サービス」を開始すると発_ _japan.cnet.com_](https://japan.cnet.com/article/35137245/)

Now, as the name suggests, the "Subscription Service" is **"a service that allows you to use akippa parking lots on a subscription basis"**, but you might have many questions, such as how it differs from a monthly parking contract or if it's really safe even if it's cheap.

So, I will briefly explain how to use this service and its features!

## How do you use it?

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856092/picture_pc_4824091998fb20d8d6f1d7fc72ec66f3.jpeg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856092/picture_pc_4824091998fb20d8d6f1d7fc72ec66f3.jpeg?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

> Mr. Sato (pseudonym), a user.
>
> His real name is Mr. Tanaka.

The akippa Subscription Service is a service you use like **this↓↓↓** (\*Note: **This service is provided entirely online (including phone and email)**. Unfortunately, it does not support voice interaction like Siri or Alexa. As someone who loves Alexa, I personally wish it did from the bottom of my heart.)

> Mr. Sato (pseudonym):
>
> OK, akippa!
>
> My workplace is scheduled to relocate in July, so I want to find a parking lot within a 10-minute walk from the nearest ◯◯ station that I can use starting July 1st! My car model is a ◯rius, and I'd like to keep it around 15,000 yen per month.
>
> akippa:
>
> Understood. We will **find a parking lot that meets your requirements**.
>
> Please wait about 1 to 2 weeks.
>
> Mr. Sato (pseudonym):
>
> OK, akippa! Thanks!

And, a few days later.

> akippa:
>
> Thank you for waiting.
>
> We found two parking lots available from July 1st.
>
> \[Parking Lot A\]
>
>  10-minute walk, 12,000 yen/month, flat-surface parking in an available space of a monthly parking lot
>
> \[Parking Lot B\]
>
>  7-minute walk, 15,000 yen/month, mechanical parking attached to an apartment building
>
> Which one would you prefer?
>
> Mr. Sato (pseudonym):
>
> Hmm, it's within budget and close, so I'll go with \[Parking Lot B\]!
>
> akippa:
>
> Understood.
>
> Once you register the necessary information and your card details, the contract will be complete.
>
> Since mechanical parking requires prior training on how to use it and a key handover, please just take care of that.
>
> Mr. Sato (pseudonym):
>
> OK, akippa! Thank you!

July 1st.

Mr. Sato (pseudonym), who had already finished the key handover, parked his car in the contracted lot and went to work.

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11861261/picture_pc_61471a2b048b5315cdbe229609600ba2.jpg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11861261/picture_pc_61471a2b048b5315cdbe229609600ba2.jpg?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

It's that simple.

Without worrying about parking fees, I'm sure he'll have a comfortable time from his first day after the relocation.

That's all, presented in the style of an AI speaker.

## How is it different from other services?

I think you've understood how to use it 120%, but as the title of Naotaro Moriyama's song ["Everywhere is a Parking Lot"](https://youtu.be/tOLsZr7Dt5k) suggests, the parking business is already a large established market.

So next, I would like to explain the **differences from other parking services**.

By the way, this "Everywhere is a Parking Lot" is the song I've been adding to the end of my karaoke sessions lately (\*Note: This is a fact).

**■ Differences from akippa** The biggest difference is the **reservation period**.

While akippa is for reservations in 15-minute or 1-day increments, this service is for **medium- to long-term use**. You can choose your desired period from options ranging from 1 month to over 13 months for continuous use.

I think it's convenient if you know you'll be using it every weekday for commuting to work or school, or if you have a fixed period of use decided, such as for home renovations.

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856138/picture_pc_02d7ef530bc1d3f1f78304dce45ec23c.png?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856138/picture_pc_02d7ef530bc1d3f1f78304dce45ec23c.png?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

> This is a review we actually received at akippa.
>
> I really hope you will use the weekday plan.

**■ Common points with akippa**

**It is based on parking space sharing.** In other words, instead of using land owned by akippa, we utilize vacant spaces such as private homes, apartment buildings, commercial facilities, and office buildings.

Furthermore, with this subscription service,

**unmanned mechanical parking lots are now also available**!

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856153/picture_pc_e5f3eed507da68f6a0334e029654408a.png?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856153/picture_pc_e5f3eed507da68f6a0334e029654408a.png?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

Mechanical parking lots are those things you often see in apartment parking lots or around town.

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856157/picture_pc_2f474f3f1ce597411ce8a7602b82b913.jpg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856157/picture_pc_2f474f3f1ce597411ce8a7602b82b913.jpg?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

> An image of an unmanned mechanical parking lot.
>
> There are various other types besides this one.

It might seem too technical and like a small change, but in reality, this is a major change.

According to a survey by the Japan Parking System Manufacturers Association, nearly 3 million mechanical parking spaces have been shipped to date.

While convenient for parking multiple vehicles in a small space, accidents can occur if not used correctly. Therefore, for safety measures, users must receive training and comply with usage procedures.

With the previous akippa, because the users changed every time, we could only utilize manned mechanical parking lots where staff were present. However, **since we can provide explanations and hand over keys in advance to users who use the service regularly, unmanned mechanical parking lots can now be shared**! Isn't that groundbreaking, if I do say so myself?

**■ Differences from monthly parking and coin-operated parking** There were many, so I summarized them in a table.

The biggest difference is perhaps that the akippa subscription service is " **cheap**."

As mentioned above, **because we share vacant spaces, there are no initial costs**, and furthermore, **we do not install new equipment**, so we can offer it at a low price.

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856167/picture_pc_5058d6303b79446701cf0f3f34188c39.png?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856167/picture_pc_5058d6303b79446701cf0f3f34188c39.png?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

When I heard about this before Golden Week, I initially thought, if I may be so bold, "Putting affordability at the forefront is very typical of an Osaka company, it's the charm of a service originating from Kansai."

But when I personally traveled by car during Golden Week, I could only find expensive parking lots, and I really felt, **"I don't want to spend money on parking."** That is the honest truth, yes.

Finally, a word from **Inoue, the service manager**!

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856170/picture_pc_3266c3e426d062212a1e4758882c1a8c.jpg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/11856170/picture_pc_3266c3e426d062212a1e4758882c1a8c.jpg?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

> Hello!
>
> Booking a parking lot you use every day on akippa each time, or paying cash at a coin-operated parking lot is **a hassle**, isn't it?
>
> With the subscription service, we will search for parking lots that meet your desired conditions from the parking lot information in the akippa network and propose them to you.
>
> Whether you have used akippa before or not, if you are looking for a parking lot for regular use, please send your desired conditions via the [request form](https://www.akippa.com/regular/request)! We are waiting for you!
>
> **\*The photo is from when I went fishing last week and successfully caught a sea bream, to celebrate the service release!**

That was a comment from Inoue, whose hobby is fishing.

Although we have announced the service, it is meaningless if it doesn't become a service that people use.

From now on, while repeating trial and error, we will create an "indispensable" service as a company that solves problems!

If you want to try it out right away, check [here](https://www.akippa.com/regular/request)!

# akippa, a parking space reservation sharing service

[![akippa広報](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/7275523/profile_fea652bec39520efedab514c4c3067f4.jpg?width=60)](https://note.com/akippa_parking)

[akippa広報](https://note.com/akippa_parking)

2018年7月30日 13:33

Nice to meet you, I am Ishikawa, the PR representative for the parking reservation app " [akippa](https://www.akippa.com/)". Thank you for opening this note.

> "I went out by car, but I was troubled because all the parking lots were full."
>
> "I had no choice but to park on the street because it was full, and I got a parking ticket."
>
> "It took time to find a parking lot, and I was late for my appointment."
>
> "When I parked in a coin-operated parking lot for a day, it was more expensive than I thought."
>
> "I had to get change to pay for parking, and my wallet became heavy."
>
> "I am troubled by the heavy traffic congestion waiting for parking at the nearby shopping center."

I am sure you have all experienced at least one of these, haven't you?

akippa is a so-called "sharing economy" service that solves such problems by matching people who want to park temporarily with private parking lots, vacant land, and other temporarily available parking spaces.

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/7306445/picture_pc_435eac330bbad5e29b1cdb5c3486df5a.jpg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/7306445/picture_pc_435eac330bbad5e29b1cdb5c3486df5a.jpg?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

Users (drivers) make reservations and payments in advance, so they just need to go to the parking lot on the day. This saves them the trouble of searching for a parking lot on-site.

On the other hand, parking lot owners can utilize their vacant land to generate revenue.

[![画像](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/7306453/picture_pc_95d408ee7933bd4263ee970112eda68b.jpg?width=1200)](https://assets.st-note.com/production/uploads/images/7306453/picture_pc_95d408ee7933bd4263ee970112eda68b.jpg?width=4000&height=4000&fit=bounds&format=jpg&quality=90)

Recently, the mobility sector has been gaining attention, with major companies entering the market and the words "Uber" and "autonomous driving" appearing more frequently in the news. Unfortunately, however, while there are about 80 million drivers nationwide, only 750,000 people use akippa. That is only 1% of all drivers (as of July 2018). We still have a long way to go...

## About our company

Our company, akippa Inc., which operates akippa, currently operates only this service as the name suggests, but from our founding in 2009 until 2014, we were a sales company.

Perhaps because of that background, there are many interesting people and cultures within the company.

Actually, I am a newcomer who just joined the company in April, but

it would be a waste to keep this to myself!

I want more people to know about akippa!

With that thought in mind, I decided to start a PR blog.

[Press releases](http://akippa.co.jp/news/) and our owned media " [Akichan](https://www.akippa.com/akichan)", I would like to update this blog with a wide range of content, focusing on topics not covered in those.

I used to update another blog in the past, but since there has been a gap of about two and a half years, I am starting fresh!
